messages:
Maya R: Flagging this thread 1: multiple customer escalations for very high p95/p99 on dedicated-eu-central-1. Seeing timeouts and 5xxs. Initial alert at 10:01 UTC.
Logan P: Confirmed. p95 jumped from ~90ms to ~1.2s, p99 up to ~3.4s. Request rate roughly flat. Dedicated pool CPU/GPU utilization not saturated.
support-bot: Escalation count: 57 errors in 12m. Affected customers: alpha-inc, beta-app, gamma-ux. Routes: /v1/chat, /v1/generate. Alert link: https://monitoring/alert/1801000000
Ashley C: Quick repro: 100 concurrent requests with 800 tokens avg. Behavior: ~40 requests got 504 client timeouts, others queued and then completed normally once workers accepted them.
Tomas V: Pulling cluster events. Noting bursts of NodeProvisioned events then Kubelet reports: "Failed to pull image: quota exceeded" and registry rate-limit warnings in node logs. Node creation time ballooned ~90s.
Maya R: Interesting. We had a change last week that increased image pull parallelism on new nodes (to speed warm-up). Maybe registry throttling now causing longer pod init. Also observed readiness probes were returning 200 before model/kernels fully loaded (pod marked Ready by k8s but not AcceptingWork).
Logan P: Diving into autoscaler/HPA: HPA scales by cpu usage but our model pods are GPU-bound and show low CPU until model load completes. HPA thresholds aren't capturing pending capacity needs. Combined with slow node provisioning and registry throttling leads to scale-up lag.
Ashley C: grab of one pod log: 
```
init-container: pulling redwood-runtime:stable
kubernetes: image pull delay, retrying
readiness-probe: OK
runtime: starting model-serving process
model-loader: loading weights, ETA 120s
```
Pod became Ready but model-loader still in progress. Meanwhile customers' requests dumped into route queue.
Tomas V: So root causes: (1) registry rate limits causing image pulls to stall during node bring-up; (2) readiness probe allowed pod Ready before model/kernels primed; (3) HPA metric mismatch for GPU-bound cold startups. Secondary: some clients retried quickly causing retry amplification.
Maya R: Immediate mitigations we can apply right now: 
- revert parallel-image-pull change (limits concurrent pulls per node)
- enforce extended readiness gating: require /healthz/serving to report READY before k8s Ready status (we can flip a feature flag)
- increase pool min_replicas from 3 -> 5 for eu-central for 30m
- enable overflow routing of non-sensitive traffic to hosted fallback model (redwood-llama-13b-small)
- add 429 with Retry-After for overloaded routes instead of transparent queueing to break retry storms
Logan P: I created a canary patch to change readiness gating and pre-pull images onto a static warm node pool. Commands I ran: 
```
kubectl get events -n dedicated-eu-central | grep ImagePullBackOff
kubectl patch deployment redwood-pool-eu-central -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"initContainers":null}}}}'
kubectl scale deployment redwood-pool-eu-central --replicas=5
```
Note: the patch above disables an init-container on canary subset that did remote kernel fetch to avoid additional registry pulls.
Ashley C: applied request-level rate limit change at edge (lowered burst to 20 reqs and 2rps steady for non-enterprise keys) and turned on 429-on-overflow. Early metrics: client retries fell ~30% in the canary.
Tomas V: I also put a temporary node pre-warm job: spin up 2 warm nodes with images pre-pulled and a single warm worker per AZ that keeps kernels cached. That reduced observed cold startup completions in the canary traffic.
support-bot: Customer comms draft queued by support: "We're investigating increased latency for Dedicated-eu-central. Root cause appears to be image pull delays causing slower pod readiness and queueing. We're deploying mitigations now (additional replicas, readiness gating, routing fallback). We'll update in 20 minutes."
Maya R: Telemetry update 10:25 UTC: canary slice p95 down from 1.2s -> 260ms, p99 down from 3.4s -> 720ms. Non-canary still elevated.
Logan P: Longer term fixes / action items: 
- change autoscaler to use custom metric (requests_pending + gpu_util) not just cpu
- implement regional registry caches / pre-pull images as a first-class warmup policy
- require readiness to include model-kernel primed signal (don't mark Ready until model served a health-check)
- add backoff/retry guidance in SDKs and expose Retry-After headers when we 429
- run a chaos test for registry-throttle scenarios to validate fallback behavior
Tomas V: Filing infra ticket for registry SLO and talk to cloud vendor on node provision variance.
Ashley C: Support: please include a repro snippet for customers: 
```
# repro script
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://dedicated-eu-central/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
Add note about increasing client-side backoff.
Maya R: I'll keep incident owner and update customers in 20m with progress. Setting status: mitigation in progress. Thanks team.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident 1801000000 status: Mitigating -> Monitoring. Next update in 20m."
